case.title: Ronin bridge (MainchainGatewayV3 proxy), Ethereum, 6 Aug 2024 (faulty upgrade, MEV whitehats)
case.period: hack: baseline before the incident, then the drain
case.notes: Upgrade to MainchainGatewayV3 left the operator-weight threshold uninitialized. First theft is native: 3,996 ETH in tx 0x26195700... (block 20,468,679, 09:37:23 UTC) by MEV bot 0x4ab12e7c...; first tracked theft 1,998,046.875 USDC (block 20,468,848) by 0x6980a47b.... Both were returned (whitehat bounty).
case.coverage: Tracked: USDC (and WETH/USDT/DAI/WBTC, no theft). The gateway holds ETH natively, so the 3,996 ETH (~$10M of ~$12M) is invisible here: only ~$2M of the theft is in this file.

source: Ethereum mainnet via public JSON-RPC (https://rpc.mevblocker.io, https://gateway.tenderly.co); built by research/bridge-hacks/03-onchain-data/fetch_more.py
price_note: USDC fixed $1; WETH at Chainlink ETH / USD 2,449.48; USDT fixed $1; DAI fixed $1; WBTC at Chainlink BTC / USD 54,837.1 (answers at block 20468679). Native ETH is not included except where it passed through WETH (rows with kind weth_wrap / weth_unwrap).
